description: Na₂NiSi₄O₁₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.83 Å. Ni is bonded to five O atoms to form NiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.14 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.66 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.66 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.61 Å) and three longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one NiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.59-1.67 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ni, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂SiNi tetrahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ni, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₂SiNi trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂SiNi tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Si₂ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂SiNi trigonal pyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Si atoms to form distorted ONa₂Si₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂SiNi tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂SiNi trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Si₂ trigonal pyramid. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
